time_window.rationale: Pool tiles are 100% NaN-free within [t=8, t=302). Earlier steps (t=1,4-7) and tail steps (t=302,303) are systematically missing in 10-21% of pool tiles and are trimmed. Verified by scripts/v4_verify_trim_zero_nan.py on full 83K pool: 0 residual NaN.
time_window.compared_to_v33: V3.3 used 302 steps (t=0..301 of the no_tail parquet). V4 uses 294 steps (t=8..301 of the raw npz). V4 starts ~6 weeks later in 2019.

tile_field_layout.expected_layout: [easting, northing, height, rmse, mean_velocity, mean_velocity_std, acceleration, acceleration_std, seasonality, seasonality_std, time_series(294)]
tile_field_layout.note: LazyTileStore must construct rows in this order from per-tile npz to remain compatible with V3.3 trainer expectations.
